42693.note: Waterfront oyster bar on Phillippi Creek with dock seating and boat access, open daily; its menu file is dated May 2026.
42693.fn: The restaurant says it was established more than 35 years ago.

42748.note: Family seafood market with a restaurant attached on the South Trail, posting October 2026 menus and daily market hours.
42748.fn: The business says it has operated since 1918, but no source gave the year it moved to this Tamiami Trail address, so the year is left blank.

43140.note: St. Armands Circle branch of the Ybor City Spanish-Cuban restaurant family, open since 1959 and listing regular daily hours after the 2024 storm flooding on the Circle.
43140.fn: Bay News 9 (July 2025) reports this St. Armands Circle restaurant opened in December 1959, the Columbia family's first expansion beyond Ybor, and calls it Sarasota's oldest restaurant; no move is reported.

43328.note: Siesta Village bar known locally as SKOB for oysters, beer and live music.

43336.note: Family-run south Siesta Key seafood compound with the Sniki Tiki bar, known for its competition-winning clam chowder.
43336.fn: The Stewart family's site says Captain Curt's Village was established in 1979.
